rationale: Adds a single videos/ line to the root .gitignore, touching one file with no open design questions and no data, trust-boundary, or release-machinery change, so it is a plain revert if undone.

signals.blast_radius: One line in the root .gitignore; no code, scripts, or CI touched
signals.unresolved: None; the proposal lists no open questions and the decision to keep videos/ local-only is already made
signals.irreversibility: Pure git revert; videos/ is untracked, so ignoring it deletes and moves nothing
